description: Windows language identifiers (MSDN [MS-LCID]) used by the plugin for the [LangOptions] LanguageID directive: completion suggestions, flag icons, English locale names, and validation. Languages bundled with Inno Setup are marked and additionally carry their Inno language name and messages file.

languages.description: All recognised Windows locales, each with an English name, its Pascal-hex LCID, a flag and whether it is bundled with Inno Setup.

displayName.description: English name of the locale shown to the user, e.g. "German (Germany)".

id.description: The Windows language identifier (LCID) in Pascal-hexadecimal form, inserted into the script, e.g. "$0407".

flag.description: Base name (without extension) of the flag SVG under /icons/flags/, e.g. "german". Omitted when no flag exists; a neutral globe icon is then used.

builtin.description: Whether this language is bundled with Inno Setup (a ready-to-use [Languages] entry). Built-in languages also provide issName and messagesFile.

issName.description: The Inno Setup language name used as the [Languages] Name value, e.g. "german" (present only for built-in languages).

messagesFile.description: Path to the bundled messages file used as the [Languages] MessagesFile value, e.g. "compiler:Languages\German.isl" (present only for built-in languages).
